# DCH round 6 guard-removal table

Serial by family and by guard or named duplicate set. Every row restores its guard before the next. No accepting shortcut or unrelated guard removal is used. Negative IDs resolve in DCH-guard-negative-index.json; “all other” means its exact complement.

Named duplicate sets retain the existing schema/semantic, scope-dispatch, selected/registered identifier and failed-exit sets. The new failed-test exit-code base/conditional minimum and maximum constrain the same slot and are removed together. The input type/domain boundary is called by several readers; removing its exact shared wrapper affects those identical calls. The encoder safe-integer gate has its own direct removal row; RFC8785/MessagePack refusal fallback remains active.
